title: Trace a photo from durable upload to feed delivery
description: Switch scenarios to see which promise changes when processing, moderation, fan-out, or CDN delivery fails. Select any node to inspect its responsibility.

nodes.label: Creator or viewer app
nodes.detail: Uploads resumable chunks, reads authoritative creator state, requests feed metadata, and fetches an eligible derivative from the CDN.

nodes.label: Upload gateway
nodes.detail: Authorizes the session, verifies chunks and checksum, commits the original, and acknowledges only confirmed durable state.

nodes.label: Original object store
nodes.detail: Preserves the accepted source so failed jobs can retry and future derivative profiles can be rebuilt without quality loss.

nodes.label: Media job stream
nodes.detail: Carries stable photo and processing versions. Consumer progress and queue age make retries and backlog visible.

nodes.label: Derivative workers
nodes.detail: Generate required sizes and formats under deterministic keys. Conditional manifest commits make repeated jobs idempotent.

nodes.label: Moderation gate
nodes.detail: Combines policy version, automated evidence, audience rules, and human review. Uncertain or blocked media is not publishable.

nodes.label: Post and feed fan-out
nodes.detail: Commits creator-visible state, emits one publication event, fans out ordinary accounts, and leaves very large accounts for read-time merge.

nodes.label: CDN and origin shield
nodes.detail: Serves an eligible device-sized derivative from a healthy edge or prepared origin path. It is never authoritative for publication state.

scenarios.label: Healthy publication
scenarios.summary: The original is sealed, workers create one derivative manifest, moderation permits the version, fan-out distributes references, and the CDN returns prepared bytes.
scenarios.result: The creator sees a monotonic published version. Follower feeds may converge later, but every reference names the same eligible immutable manifest.

scenarios.label: Processor outage
scenarios.summary: Ingest remains available, but derivative workers cannot consume the durable job stream. The system preserves accepted originals and honest processing state.
scenarios.result: Publication stops and queue age rises. Scaling or failover resumes deterministic jobs later; no feed or CDN path receives an incomplete manifest.

scenarios.label: Duplicate job retry
scenarios.summary: A lease expires after outputs were written, so another worker receives the same photo and processing version. Deterministic keys and a conditional commit elect one publisher.
scenarios.result: The retry verifies or reuses existing objects. Only the winning manifest transition emits publication, preventing duplicate posts and feed amplification.

scenarios.label: Moderation hold
scenarios.summary: Derivatives are ready, but policy evidence is uncertain and requires review. Performance dependencies are healthy; eligibility is not.
scenarios.result: The creator sees review state, and broad discovery waits. A warm derivative or high rank score cannot bypass the policy gate.

scenarios.label: Follower fan-out lag
scenarios.summary: Publication commits successfully, but follower inbox consumers are behind. Authoritative profile state and derivative delivery remain healthy.
scenarios.result: The creator can read the published post immediately while follower feeds converge. The system reports publication-to-follower lag instead of rolling back durable state.

scenarios.label: CDN region outage
scenarios.summary: A delivery region cannot serve the selected derivative. Publication and feed metadata are still correct, so delivery routes to a healthy edge or prepared origin shield.
scenarios.result: Image start may slow or use a smaller prepared derivative. The fallback never serves the unprocessed original or changes publication authority.

scenarios.label: Urgent takedown
scenarios.summary: A published version is removed after a new moderation decision. Authoritative state advances first, then feed tombstones and CDN purge requests propagate asynchronously.
scenarios.result: New reads deny the removed version before every cache purge completes. Tombstones clean follower feeds, and stale URLs do not restore authorization.
